title: glyceria capillaris
intro: Glyceria capillaris, commonly known as Mann's grass or buffalo grass, is a perennial grass species native to Europe and North America. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Glyceria capillaris include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which can help relieve respiratory issues and alleviate muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of Glyceria capillaris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
